problems: Enquiries from JustDial, Sulekha, Shiksha, CollegeDunia and walk-ins that nobody follows up in time

faqs.q: Do you work with institutions that already have an ERP?
faqs.a: Yes. We can migrate you to Friensys, or integrate AI and new modules with the system you already use.

faqs.q: How do you handle student data?
faqs.a: Student data is personal data under the DPDP Act. We design consent flows and data processing agreements before any AI touches it.
